dedupe_keys.name: chinese state grid wind and solar forecasting data

description: This research deposit provides weather and power-generation data from six wind farms and eight solar stations in China for 2019–2020 at 15-minute resolution. It supports the Chinese State Grid renewable-generation forecasting competition. Figshare supplies original and processed RAR packages, example Excel station files and correlation figures under CC0, with free access. The companion GitHub repository names notebooks for visualising original and processed variables; no explicit notebook licence was found, and they are included as supporting methods, not a separately licensed dataset. The time series can calibrate renewable-generation forecasts and test scheduling assumptions for power-system simulations such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that preprocessing may change missing values and outliers, so users should select the appropriate version and retain its processing history. A small group of stations does not represent every Chinese climate or technology. No measurement files were downloaded and no forecast or notebook was run.
